audit_items.proof_trace: In Sui Move, Coin<CoinType> is a linear owned type — the VM enforces the caller owns the coin, so the payer's balance is provably reduced when reserve.repay_amount(coin) consumes it after the refund split. The borrower's obligation debt is reduced by obligation.repay_debt() → unsafe_repay_debt_only(), which directly mutates the debt entry in the obligation's debts table. Both postconditions hold on all code paths with no bypass.
